findings.title: `firstName` returns the last name instead of first name
findings.body: The function uses `split(" ")[1]` which returns index 1 (the second word), but the first name is at index 0. For "Ada Lovelace", this returns "Lovelace" instead of "Ada".

findings.title: Single-word names return undefined
findings.body: For a single name like "John", `split(" ")[1]` returns `undefined`, producing "Welcome back, undefined!"
findings.suggestion: Add handling for single-word names or check array bounds

findings.title: Multi-word names return wrong name
findings.body: For names like "Jane Doe Smith", this returns the middle name "Doe" instead of the first name "Jane".
findings.suggestion: Use `split(" ")[0]` to always get the first word

findings.title: Test doesn't verify correct name extraction
findings.body: The test only checks that output matches `/^Welcome back, /` which is too loose - it doesn't verify the first name is actually correct. This weak assertion let the bug pass.
findings.evidence: Test uses regex that only checks prefix, not the actual name
findings.suggestion: Add assertions that verify the exact first name extracted, e.g., `expect(welcomeBack("Ada Lovelace")).toBe("Welcome back, Ada!")`
